title: Deep-Cleaning Turnover Addition to the Short-Stay Share — Listings Decision Card
content:
# Deep-Cleaning Turnover Addition to the Short-Stay Share

*Decision card for Roamhaven Listings, read against the listing's Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims.*

When the short-stay cleaning fee of a listing is saved, the approved Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims in the deep cleaning category filed on the listing within the last twenty-four months are counted.

| Approved deep-cleaning HostCover claims filed on the listing within the last twenty-four months | Added to the listing's short-stay share |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.08 |
| exactly 1 | 0.04 |
| none | nothing |

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical listings)

- **Input:** 1 approved deep-cleaning claim filed eight months ago. **Judgement:** exactly one. **Output:** 0.04 added.
- **Input:** 2 approved deep-cleaning claims, one filed three months ago and one twenty months ago. **Judgement:** two or more. **Output:** 0.08 added.
- **Input:** 1 withdrawn deep-cleaning claim. **Judgement:** none approved. **Output:** nothing added.
